_comment: Domain-focused probe set for Alexei's workloads: coding (multiple langs), systems/OS/driver code, platform & software architecture, ESXi/hypervisor code analysis. Plus contrast categories (prose, math, translation) so specialization contrast is measurable. 4 prompts/category, varied phrasing, lengths in a narrow band. Goal: does GLM-5.2's router concentrate on these technical domains enough to exploit a hot-expert tier?
code_c_systems: Write a C function that safely copies a fixed-size buffer and returns the number of bytes written.
In C, explain how a memory barrier prevents instruction reordering on a multicore CPU.
Refactor this C loop to reduce cache misses when iterating a large struct array.
Write a C signal handler that is async-signal-safe and explain why printf is not.
code_kernel_driver: Explain how a Linux character device driver registers a file_operations struct and handles ioctl.
Write the probe and remove functions for a minimal PCI driver in the Linux kernel.
Describe how DMA-coherent memory is allocated and mapped for a device in a kernel driver.
Explain how an interrupt handler top-half and bottom-half (tasklet/workqueue) split work.
esxi_hypervisor: Explain how an ESXi native driver differs from a vmklinux driver and why VMware deprecated vmklinux.
Describe how a VMkernel module registers with the VMKAPI device layer to expose a network uplink.
How does ESXi PCI passthrough (DirectPath I/O) present a physical device to a guest VM?
Explain how the ESXi world scheduler places vCPU worlds across pCPUs and NUMA nodes.
software_architecture: Explain the trade-offs between a monolith and microservices for a latency-sensitive service.
Describe how you would design a write-ahead log for durability in a storage engine.
Compare an actor model and a shared-memory threading model for a high-concurrency server.
Explain how a consistent-hashing ring distributes keys and handles node addition and removal.
code_python: Write a Python function that merges two sorted lists into one sorted list.
In Python, explain the difference between a generator and a list comprehension.
Refactor this Python snippet to avoid a nested loop: for a in xs: for b in ys: if a==b: out.append(a).
Write a Python context manager that times the block it wraps and logs the duration.
code_sql: Write a SQL query that returns the top 5 customers by total order value.
Explain what a LEFT JOIN does differently from an INNER JOIN in SQL.
Write SQL to add an index on the email column of a users table and explain when it helps.
Explain how a query planner decides between a hash join and a nested-loop join.
prose_story: Write the opening paragraph of a short story about a lighthouse keeper.
Describe a bustling market square using only sensory detail, no dialogue.
Write a reflective diary entry about the last day of summer.
Compose a brief character sketch of an old clockmaker who never sleeps.
math_proof: Prove that the square root of 2 is irrational.
Show that the sum of the first n odd numbers equals n squared.
Explain why the derivative of e^x is e^x.
Prove that there are infinitely many prime numbers.
translation_de: Translate to German: The network driver failed to allocate a DMA buffer.
Translate to German: Please restart the hypervisor after applying the patch.
Translate to German: The scheduler balances virtual CPUs across physical cores.
Translate to German: Memory pressure caused the guest to be swapped to disk.
